category_4_contract_mismatches.description: Both sides exist but response shape or request format does not match

entries.finding: RAG GUI endpoints use `_documents: list[dict] = []` — a module-level in-memory list, not the PostgreSQL DB. GET /rag/documents always returns empty after backend restart. POST /rag/import persists only in RAM. POST /rag/retrieve searches this fake list, not the real search index. Frontend RAGCenterPage.jsx operates on a completely separate data store from DocumentsPage/ImportCenterPage.
entries.impact: Documents imported via /documents/import are invisible to /rag/documents and vice versa. Any retrieval test is meaningless.
entries.action_required: rag_gui.py must be refactored to use real DB session and SearchService. Or RAGCenterPage must be clearly marked as a debug/prototype tool.

entries.finding: rag.js sends FormData (multipart). Backend ImportRequest is a Pydantic BaseModel expecting JSON body (title, content, classification, source_url). Type mismatch: FormData vs application/json.
entries.impact: Latent bug — RAGCenterPage.jsx currently only shows an alert() instead of calling rag.js importDocument. If the real call is ever wired up, it will return 422 Unprocessable Entity.
entries.action_required: Either change rag.js to send JSON, or change backend to accept file upload. Align with the real /documents/import approach.

entries.finding: Backend returns AnalysisJobListResponse { items: [...], total, limit, offset }. Frontend analysis.js returns raw response. No frontend page currently calls listAnalysisJobs() and unpacks .items. If a page renders `raw` directly as an array, it will render the wrapper object instead. Risk: Medium — depends on consumer implementation.
entries.action_required: Any consumer of listAnalysisJobs() must unwrap .items. Document this contract explicitly.

entries.finding: Backend chat.py uses UnconfiguredLlmProvider which throws RuntimeError('LLM provider is not configured') at runtime. The endpoint exists and accepts the request (no schema mismatch), but will always return HTTP 500 in production without LLM configuration.
entries.impact: ChatPage is fully broken at runtime. Not a schema mismatch but a runtime contract failure.
entries.action_required: P1-GAP-05: LLM provider must be configured. Or return a structured 503 error instead of 500.

entries.finding: Backend returns list[SearchChunkResult] — a plain array with no total_count wrapper. Frontend useSearch.js expects Array.isArray(raw) — MATCH for shape. But frontend cannot display 'X Treffer gefunden' because total is missing. Known gap SP-04 from search_quality_report.json.
entries.action_required: Wrap in SearchChunkListResponse { items: [...], total: int } or add X-Total-Count header.
